question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority within the Chinese Communist Party drives the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Extensive purges of senior military and civilian officials have centralized power in his hands and the Central Military Commission, while the abolition of term limits and lack of any designated successor or visible factional opposition limit pathways for early departure. The 21st Party Congress, expected in late 2027, remains the scheduled venue for leadership decisions, with Xi positioned to secure a fourth term amid ongoing generational turnover among other top cadres. Recent months have shown no major health disclosures, public challenges, or institutional shifts that would alter this trajectory. Unforeseen developments such as a sudden medical event or elite-level upheaval could still intervene before year-end, though such scenarios lack supporting indicators.
